The surname '''Torfinn''' can refer to the following people:

*[[Jaim Torfinn]] - a farmer from the [[Two Rivers]] and said to be a good archer.
*[[Jancy Torfinn]] - a girl from [[Emond's Field]] and [[Novice]] in the [[Rebel Aes Sedai|Tower in exile]].
*[[Leof Torfinn]] - a young man from the Two Rivers, scarred by [[Trolloc]]s.
*[[Nat Torfinn]] - an old man from the Two Rivers.
*[[Thad Torfinn]] - a farmer from the Two Rivers.
